_meta.name: elasticnet
_meta.description: Elastic net regression: REG_OLS with penalty elasticnet, alpha 1000 and l1_ratio 0.5, half lasso and half ridge, by coordinate descent: label's coefficient goes to exactly 0 and price shrinks (about 13.6 against OLS's 17.5). Like the lasso (06_lasso.json) it reports null standard errors, p-values and intervals with advisory PULSE_ADVISORY_PENALIZED_INFERENCE_UNDEFINED; resample bootstrap gives replicate ones. Streamable.
